messages:
marta: heads-up — got a spike of 413s hitting /v1/embeddings this morning, mostly from one customer.
samir: any pattern on dims or payload size?
marta: preliminary: mixed dims payloads, large arrays (~1.2MB) and some 4096-dim vectors.
lee: 1.2MB shouldn't 413 unless our front proxy or nginx limit. Which layer returned 413? infra-bot: PROXY: 413 Payload Too Large returned by api-gw-03 for request id a9f3b2
natalie: logs show our splitter tried to pre-split but FAILED preflight check: "dim-mismatch: mixed dims without dim header"
samir: oof — clients are sending mixed dims in a single batch and not setting x-embed-dim. splitter currently requires dim header to shard.
dennis: can we infer dims server-side for a best-effort fallback? that would avoid 413s.
lee: inference is doable but expensive CPU-wise and a runtime hazard for latency SLOs. we could do async sniffing in preflight path with a cheap sample.
marta: customer said they send heterogeneous vectors from a legacy pipeline. they expect us to accept them, not 413.
console-ux: UX note — the console currently shows a generic 413 but no hint about "mixed dims". customers are confused.
natalie: telemetry only emits error_rate and 413 counts -> no dimensionality signal today. we need a metric like embed.dim_inferred and embed.dim_mismatch_count.
samir: agreed. proposal: add two telemetry fields: embed.dim_hint_present (bool) per request, and embed.dim_modes (list of dims seen) as histogram. cheaper: emit dim_count and samples in debug logs.
dennis: operationally we can route requests without dim header to a "lenient" shard pool that does inference+splitting, but that pool should be rate-limited.
lee: routing idea: policy = prefer fast-path (strict splitter) -> fallback to lenient pool if preflight fails AND request size < 2MB. else fail fast.
marta: the 2MB number okay? our api-gw/ingress limit is 4MB currently, but downstream services have 2MB boundaries.
samir: we should avoid magic numbers. instead use negotiated Preflight which returns a small JSON telling client to split or accept fallback. e.g., client does a HEAD-ish preflight call.
console-ux: if we add Preflight API, console can show per-route preflight errors and suggest client-side split. much better UX.
natalie: telemetry plan: emit preflight_attempt, preflight_result{ok,fallback,fail}, and a sample payload signature (sha1 string) for dedup.
dennis: config flags: rollout preflight opt-in for 2 weeks, default off. during opt-in we keep current behavior.
lee: implementation tasks: 1) lightweight dim-sample routine (C++), 2) preflight endpoint + client docs, 3) lenient pool + quota guard, 4) telemetry events. estimate 2 sprints.
marta: can we do a quick patch: when splitter sees mixed dims and no header, return 400 with message telling client to set x-embed-dim or call /v1/embeds/preflight? we can ship this today.
samir: yes do that. better than 413.
console-ux: change console error mapping: 400+code mixed_dims -> friendly message + link to suggested split snippet.
lee: snippet idea: ```python
# suggested client-side split
for chunk in chunked(payload, max_bytes=1_000_000):
    client.embeddings.create(input=chunk, headers={"x-embed-dim": "1536"})
```
Natalie: also add alert: embed.preflight_fail_rate > 1% per minute triggers paging during rollout.
dennis: rollout plan: feature-flag preflight on orgs selected via console toggles. docs + quota caveats called out.
marta: any objections to adding inferred-dim telemetry? privacy?
samir: it's just numeric dims (e.g., 1536) and count, no PII. should be fine. check legal but low risk.
console-ux: will add one-liner explainer in console: "What does dim mean?" -> link to docs.
lee: follow-ups: I will open PR for preflight 400 change, include sample log lines. natalie will add telemetry events and dashboards. dennis will provision lenient pool skeleton. console-ux will add mapping and tips. samir will draft API doc for preflight.
marta: thanks. quick customer comms: I'll tell them we will avoid 413s and recommend preflight split.
samir: one final note: longer-term we should support mixed-dim embedding arrays via an ingest pipeline that canonicalizes dims into separate sub-requests; but that's a bigger project.
lee: agreed. milestone: preflight 400 patch -> today. telemetry + dashboard -> next week. lenient pool -> next sprint.
infra-bot: deploybot: deploy queued for api-gw-03 with tag fixes/preflight-400, ETA ~15m
marta: :thumbsup:
